title: Flipper Forge
description: Design your own pinball table with bumpers, kickers, ramps and spinners, then flip your way to a high score.
concept: A pinball table architect and arcade in one. Switch to Build mode to paint a 6x7 grid with five element types — bumpers, kickers, ramps and spinners — or start from a preset layout. Switch to Play mode to charge the plunger, work the flippers, and chase combo multipliers across a 3-ball game with real Verlet-style collision physics.
features: Build mode: 5-element tile editor (bumper, kicker, ramp /, ramp \, spinner) plus 3 presets
Play mode: physics pinball with charge-and-release plunger, dual flippers, combo scoring, 3-ball games
Persistent table + high score via localStorage, auto-loaded on return
Export table as a downloadable JSON file
Share your table via a copyable URL hash link
tech: Rotating flipper capsule physics with angular-velocity kick
Pointer + keyboard input (touch flip buttons, arrow keys, spacebar)

interaction.mouse: Click grid cells in Build mode to place the selected tool; click flipper/launch buttons in Play mode
interaction.click: Toolbar selects the active element; presets instantly load a layout
interaction.touch: Tap to place tiles; on-screen FLIP and LAUNCH buttons control the table on mobile
interaction.keyboard: Arrow Left/Right flip the paddles, hold Space to charge the plunger and release to launch
